title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：miracle　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 miracle 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the counsellor ① worked the miracle that no listener in the garden would have recorded, and he said the working was the whole of the evening. The ② miracle, meaning the wonder itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed unrecorded in the book; a miracle, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ miracle in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ miracle at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A miracle, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the counsellor said the recording is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the miracle was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the wonder. The ⑥ miracle, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; miracle, he said, is either something you work or the only word that means both a wonder and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1970 the ⑦ miracle had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ miracle of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of recording; miracle, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ miracle I remember is the wonder recorded in the journal, which closed in 1972 and is still recorded as the quietest in the garden. A ⑩ miracle, my mother said in 1974, is the only wonder that improves by being recorded; every miracle, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like a wonder. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 奇迹（指小园里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 奇迹（指那个奇迹本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：work the miracle 创造这一个奇迹
D. n. 奇迹（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 奇迹之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的奇迹之事）
F. n. 奇迹（指心记里写到、被记载的那一个）
G. n. 奇迹、盼望（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 盼望（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: worked the miracle that no listener in the garden would have recorded
The miracle, meaning the wonder itself and not the letter
the miracle at the far bench
the miracle was the whole of the matter
the miracle had become a line in a journal
The miracle of the whole thing
A miracle, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: work the miracle 意为“创造这一个奇迹”，1965 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯记载的一个奇迹做了一遍。
miracle 意为“奇迹”，指那个奇迹本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被记载。
miracle 意为“奇迹”，指小园里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
miracle 意为“奇迹”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
miracle 意为“奇迹、盼望”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个盼望就是那件事的全部。
miracle 意为“盼望”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个奇迹，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
miracle 意为“奇迹”，指心记里写到、被记载的那一个，到 1970 年这一个成了心记里的一行。
miracle 意为“奇迹之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的奇迹之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的记载。
miracle 意为“奇迹”，我记得的是心记里记载过的那一个，1972 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一个。
miracle 为抽象总称，母亲 1974 年说，奇迹是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的奇迹。
